originalScores.interpretation: Relative observations about the original source against the chosen warm soft direction; no numeric approval threshold.

observations: Original front identity is clear at logical size: light golden face, ginger fringe, circular black glasses, navy folded cap and orange apron/tie are immediately recognizable. This is the identity to retain while improving native design.

The source cap is a broad slab-like crown over a thick straight dark band and projecting brim; front/back planes remain flat and sparsely articulated. Target replaces that impression with soft crown volume, curved brim and restrained edge construction. Native reconstruction should achieve this improvement within source height/camera, without copying target framing.

Original face, ears, nose, cuffs, palms and torso use hard planar transitions. White sleeves have sharp gray facets in side work/hold poses; target has rounder skin/cloth transitions and clearer collar/cuff layering. The target friendly eyes/smile and soft cheeks are useful aesthetic cues, without locking exact facial proportions.

N view exposes an orderly wall of similarly sized orange curl pellets and large blank cap/coat planes. More purposeful curl massing and garment construction can improve the back and side views; the target is front-only, so exact unseen details are not established.

Original orange apron front and bow/pocket mostly merge into a flat warm block at logical size. Target straps, pocket edging and fastenings give readable clothing structure. Such details should remain subordinate to the face/cap and avoid noisy stitches at game size.

Original action atlases show subtle idle motion, a front cooking pose with visible dimensional knife during work, a readable2D salmon display during hold/load, and expected back-view occlusion of held food. All192 source frames were inspected on neutral gray; sixteen state/facing first frames also inspected on light and dark.

Native audit confirms all required source clips, publisher rotations, body envelope and evaluated attachment behavior. Collection visibility initially caused stale evaluation; after enabling the actual source collection in an isolated scene, source nominal height, bob, palms, knife and dish paths evaluated coherently.

Source load is an outward-and-return presentation, not a release into the belt. Its retained dish and symmetric samples are deliberate baseline facts for this review, irrespective of the catalog state name.
